# 淨土十要

**Byline:** 明 成時(評點節要)
**Dynasty:** 明

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The **definitive late-imperial Pure Land anthology** — a curated selection of ten essential Pure Land texts (the "Ten Essentials") with editorial annotations (*píngdiǎn* 評點) and abridgement (*jiéyào* 節要) by [成時](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%88%90%E6%99%82) **Jiānmì Chéngshí** 堅密成時 (1618–1678), dharma heir of [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** 蕅益智旭 (1599–1655). The original selection of the ten texts was made by Ǒuyì Zhìxù; Chéngshí completed the editorial apparatus after Ǒuyì's death and circulated the work in its present form during his own abbacy, in the late-Shùnzhì / early-Kāngxī period.

**Abstract**

The "ten essentials" comprise the canonical reading list of late-imperial Pure Land doctrinal study, drawn from the Tiāntái Pure Land tradition (the *Shíyí lùn* attributed to Zhìyǐ [KR6p0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0036); the *Jìngtǔ shēng wúshēng lùn* of Chuándēng [KR6p0056](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0056); the *Jìngtǔ huòwèn* of Tiānrú [KR6p0053](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0053)); the late-Sòng / Yuán synthesis (the *Lónshū jìngtǔ wén* of Wáng Rìxiū [KR6p0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0050)); the late-Míng synthesis (Yúnqī's *Dá sìshíbā wèn* [KR6p0063](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0063) and the *Xīfāng yuànwén* [KR6p0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0064); Yuán Hóngdào's *Xīfāng hélùn* [KR6p0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0057)); and Ǒuyì's own *Ēmítuó jīng yàojiě* 阿彌陀經要解 (his masterwork of Pure Land doctrinal commentary). The selection is therefore a **canonical pedagogical map** of the doctrinal tradition: organised genealogically rather than thematically, the ten essentials together demonstrate the unity of the Pure Land tradition from Suí-Táng through late Míng.

Chéngshí's editorial work is substantial but unobtrusive. The *píngdiǎn* annotations supply doctrinal cross-references and brief explanatory glosses; the *jiéyào* abridgements remove material that Chéngshí (following Ǒuyì) judged less central, producing readable working editions of the selected texts. The result is a single compact anthology that can serve as a complete Pure Land doctrinal-pedagogical curriculum — the function it has continuously served in Chinese Pure Land seminary education from the seventeenth century to the present.

The text is preserved only in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏 (X1164). The dating bracket adopted (1655–1678) covers from the death of Ǒuyì Zhìxù (after which Chéngshí became the principal transmitter of his master's line) to Chéngshí's own death.
